chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Salamah, from Abu 'Abd Allah, from his father, peace be upon them:
“Indeed, Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام used to cut off the thief’s hand for a quarter of a dinar.”

key_terms.أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام in this report
key_terms.رُبُعِ دِينَارٍ: a quarter of a dinar; the monetary threshold mentioned for the ruling
key_terms.يَقْطَعُ: he would amputate; meaning he would carry out the hadd punishment for theft
key_terms.ٱلسَّارِقَ: the thief; the one legally established to have committed theft

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount for which the hadd punishment for theft is applied in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the legal threshold at which the hadd punishment for theft was carried out by Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام. It indicates that the ruling applied when the stolen amount reached a quarter of a dinar, reflecting a specific juristic standard in theft law.
